verdict.rationale: Jira clearly exposes a REST API, documented through an OpenAPI spec, a versioned v3 reference, and a REST API policy covering deprecation. None of these evidence items mention documented rate limits, request quotas, or concurrency caps, so the axis applies but this capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale
